_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA/uHAF kidney labels, assigned from the 50-gene deep marker sets (heca_markers_deep_Kidney.json) and NOT from the label string. Where markers contradict the label, the markers decide. 'null' = markers too non-specific to assign (abstention), a valid curation outcome that must not be scored as a miss.
_disagrees_with_label: Neuroglial cell (CLDN6/AGR2/POU3F3 = epithelial, nothing neural); Juxtaglomerular cell (CDH5/KDR/ECSCR/APLNR = endothelial, not the modified smooth muscle a JG cell is); Myofibroblast (PRRX1/SFRP2/OGN/FBLN2 = fibroblast, no ACTA2 or TAGLN); Epithelial cell (EHHADH/ALDH8A1/WDR72 = proximal tubule specifically); Myeloid cell (FCN1/S100A8/CSTA = monocyte)
